projectDescription: A header-only, template-based C++20 linear algebra engine providing dense vectors, matrices, and numerical decompositions with compile-time type safety via concepts.
keyFeatures: Header-only — include a single file and start using
C++20 concepts enforce NumericType, RealType, and IntegralType at compile time
Dense Vector<V> with L1/L2/L∞/Lp norms, dot product, outer product, and reshape
Fixed-size Vector3D<T> with cross product, scalar triple product, and vector triple product
Dense Matrix<M> with row-major storage, arithmetic operators, and statistical reductions
LU decomposition with partial pivoting (PA = LU) for determinant, rank, inverse, and solve
Cholesky factorization (A = LLᵀ) for SPD matrices and least-squares via normal equations
Householder QR factorization (A = QR) for least-squares and rank detection
Singular Value Decomposition (A = UΣVᵀ) with Golub–Kahan iteration, pseudoinverse, and condition number
Mixed-type arithmetic via Numeric<T,S> = std::common_type_t promotion
Configurable I/O formatting for matrices and vectors via MatrixFormat / VectorFormat
Compile-time domain-check policy (DomainCheck::Enable / Disable) for transcendental functions
RESTRICT-qualified raw pointer loops for SIMD-friendly performance
publicApiSurface: Linea::sin / cos / tan / sqrt / log / exp (element-wise free functions)
